state.short_description: Two-letter abbreviation of the state whose school immunization assessment the row comes from.
state.long_description: Two-letter abbreviation of the state whose school immunization assessment the row comes from. Each state runs its own assessment with its own grade, series definitions, and denominators, so levels are comparable within a state over time but not across states.

grade.short_description: Grade the assessment covers: 6th, 7th, or Adolescent (Alaska's registry series, ages 13-17).
grade.long_description: Grade the assessment covers. Most states assess the grade at which adolescent vaccines are required for school entry: 7th in CT, MA, ND, TX, and WA (from 2020-21), 6th in LA and WA (through 2019-20); Indiana reports both 6th and 7th. Alaska's rows are labelled Adolescent because they come from the state immunization registry for ages 13-17 rather than a school survey.

N_enrolled.long_name: Number of students enrolled or assessed in the grade
N_enrolled.short_description: Number of students in the grade the rates are based on. Not published by Alaska, Louisiana, or Texas.
N_enrolled.long_description: Number of students enrolled or assessed in the grade, as published by the state; the denominator for the rate columns where available. Missing for Alaska, Louisiana, and Texas, which do not publish it.

school_adol_pct_tdap.long_name: Percent of students up to date for Tdap
school_adol_pct_tdap.short_description: Percent of assessed students up to date for the tetanus, diphtheria, and pertussis (Tdap) booster.
school_adol_pct_tdap.long_description: Percent of assessed students in the grade reported as up to date for the Tdap booster in the state's annual school immunization assessment. The series definition, the grade assessed, and whether the denominator is all enrolled students or only those surveyed vary by state. Reported by AK, CT, IN, LA, MA, ND, and TX.
school_adol_pct_tdap.statement: In {location}, {value}% of students were up to date for Tdap

school_adol_pct_menacwy.long_name: Percent of students up to date for meningococcal conjugate (MenACWY) vaccine
school_adol_pct_menacwy.short_description: Percent of assessed students up to date for meningococcal conjugate (MenACWY) vaccine.
school_adol_pct_menacwy.long_description: Percent of assessed students in the grade reported as up to date for meningococcal conjugate (MenACWY, also called MCV4) vaccine in the state's annual school immunization assessment. The series definition, the grade assessed, and the denominator vary by state. Reported by AK, CT, IN, LA, MA, ND, and TX.
school_adol_pct_menacwy.statement: In {location}, {value}% of students were up to date for MenACWY

school_adol_pct_hpv.long_name: Percent of adolescents up to date for HPV vaccine
school_adol_pct_hpv.short_description: Percent of adolescents up to date for human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine. Alaska only; HPV is not a school entry requirement elsewhere.
school_adol_pct_hpv.long_description: Percent of adolescents aged 13-17 up to date for HPV vaccine, from Alaska's immunization registry report. No other state in this file requires HPV for school entry, so no other state reports it.
school_adol_pct_hpv.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adolescents were up to date for HPV vaccine

school_adol_pct_complete.long_name: Percent of students complete for all required vaccines
school_adol_pct_complete.short_description: Percent of assessed students up to date for every vaccine the state requires at that grade.
school_adol_pct_complete.long_description: Percent of assessed students in the grade reported as complete or up to date for every vaccine the state requires at that grade. Which vaccines that includes differs by state. Reported by AK, CT, LA, and WA.
school_adol_pct_complete.statement: In {location}, {value}% of students had all required vaccines

school_adol_pct_medical_exempt.long_name: Percent of students with a medical exemption
school_adol_pct_medical_exempt.short_description: Percent of students in the grade with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
school_adol_pct_medical_exempt.long_description: Percent of students in the grade with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines, as published by the state. Connecticut reports it against the full required series. Reported by CT, MA, ND, and WA.
school_adol_pct_medical_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value}% of students had a medical exemption

school_adol_pct_religious_exempt.long_name: Percent of students with a religious exemption
school_adol_pct_religious_exempt.short_description: Percent of students in the grade with a religious exemption from one or more required vaccines.
school_adol_pct_religious_exempt.long_description: Percent of students in the grade with a religious exemption from one or more required vaccines, as published by the state. Connecticut ended new religious exemptions in 2021 but existing ones carry forward. Reported by CT, MA, ND, and WA.
school_adol_pct_religious_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value}% of students had a religious exemption

school_adol_pct_personal_exempt.long_name: Percent of students with a personal or philosophical exemption
school_adol_pct_personal_exempt.short_description: Percent of students in the grade with a personal belief (conscientious or philosophical) exemption.
school_adol_pct_personal_exempt.long_description: Percent of students in the grade with a personal belief exemption from one or more required vaccines; Texas calls these conscientious exemptions. Reported by ND, TX, and WA.
school_adol_pct_personal_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value}% of students had a personal belief exemption

school_adol_pct_full_exempt.long_name: Percent of students with any exemption
school_adol_pct_full_exempt.short_description: Percent of students in the grade with any exemption (medical, religious, or personal) from one or more required vaccines.
school_adol_pct_full_exempt.long_description: Percent of students in the grade with any exemption from one or more required vaccines, as published by the state. Reported by LA, MA, and WA; states that publish only the separate exemption types have no value here.
school_adol_pct_full_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value}% of students had an exemption

suppressed_flag.long_name: State suppressed at least one rate on the row
suppressed_flag.short_description: 1 if the state withheld at least one rate on the row to protect a small count; the withheld value is missing, not imputed.
suppressed_flag.long_description: 1 if the state withheld at least one rate on the row to protect a small count, 0 otherwise. Withheld values are left missing. Only Texas publishes suppression markers; rates that were simply not reported are missing with the flag at 0.

school_immunizations.name: PopHIVE school immunization assessments
school_immunizations.organization: PopHIVE, Yale School of Public Health
school_immunizations.location: Per-state standard files and source notes
school_immunizations.description: State health departments publish the results of their annual school-entry immunization assessments in different formats (open data portals, workbooks, PDF reports, registry reports). The PopHIVE school_immunizations repository ingests each state into a wide standard file keyed by school year, county, and grade. This source takes the states that publish adolescent-grade (6th or 7th grade, or a registry adolescent series) Tdap, MenACWY, or HPV coverage, keeps their county and state rows, and maps each state's columns onto a common set. Coverage definitions, the grade assessed, and denominators vary by state; compare within a state over time rather than across states. Connecticut reports by county through 2023-24 and by planning region from 2024-25. Washington assessed 6th grade through 2019-20 and 7th grade from 2020-21.
school_immunizations.restrictions: Public data published by the state agencies; no access restrictions. Cite the state source for a given state.

ak_school_immunization.name: Alaska Vaccination Coverage Report, Kindergarten and Adolescent Series
ak_school_immunization.organization: Alaska Department of Health, Division of Public Health
ak_school_immunization.description: Quarterly report built from VacTrAK, Alaska's immunization registry, rather than from a school-entry survey. The adolescent series (ages 13-17) gives Tdap, HPV, MenACWY, and an overall up-to-date rate for the state, Anchorage, and public health regions; only the state and Anchorage rows have FIPS codes and are kept.
ak_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.

ct_school_immunization.name: Connecticut School Immunization and Exemption Rates
ct_school_immunization.description: CT Open Data dataset 8kid-pp5k gives, for grades Pre-K, K, and 7th and each required vaccine series, enrolment plus coverage, religious and medical exemption, and non-compliance rates by county (planning region from 2024-25) and statewide. The 2024-25 7th-grade statewide row is short of the sum of its planning regions, as DPH published it.
ct_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.

in_school_immunization.name: Indiana School Immunization Coverage
in_school_immunization.description: County-level, multi-grade antigen coverage from the Indiana Department of Health open-data hub. The 6th and 7th grade rows are kept. The hub files carry no exemption split.
in_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.

la_school_immunization.name: Louisiana School Immunization Coverage
la_school_immunization.description: Parish-level coverage and exemption rates from a multi-year Louisiana Office of Public Health school immunization workbook; the 6th grade rows are kept.
la_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data. Ingested upstream from a committed workbook because the LDH online dashboard is behind authentication.

ma_school_immunization.name: Massachusetts School Immunization Survey
ma_school_immunization.description: County-level kindergarten and 7th-grade coverage and exemption rates from the annual MDPH by-county school immunization workbooks; the 7th grade rows are kept.
ma_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.

nd_school_immunization.name: North Dakota School Immunization Coverage
nd_school_immunization.organization: North Dakota Health and Human Services
nd_school_immunization.description: County-level school immunization coverage and exemption rates from the ND HHS coverage-rate reports; the 7th grade county rows are kept and the school rows are not.
nd_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.

tx_school_immunization.name: Texas School Immunization Coverage
tx_school_immunization.organization: Texas Department of State Health Services
tx_school_immunization.description: County-level school immunization and conscientious exemption rates from the annual DSHS Annual Report of Immunization Status; the 7th grade county and state rows are kept. DSHS suppresses small cells, which are flagged here.
tx_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.

wa_school_immunization.name: Washington School Immunization Data
wa_school_immunization.description: County-level school immunization completion and exemption rates from the WA DOH school immunization reports. The adolescent assessment covered 6th grade through 2019-20 and 7th grade from 2020-21. Washington publishes completion and exemptions but no Tdap or MenACWY rate.
wa_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
